# ecoplus Provider

Terraform provider for the ecoplus controller, which pools Hetzner Cloud servers to avoid paying for unused billed hours.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "ecoplus" {
  endpoint = "https://ecoplus.internal:8080"
  token    = var.ecoplus_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the ecoplus controller. Falls back to the `ECOPLUS_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token for the controller. Falls back to the `ECOPLUS_TOKEN` environment variable.
